- File: tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py
  Line or code reference: lines 44-67, function test_moved_steps_run_only_the_resolving_wrapper, the expected_lines f-strings for indices 1 and 2
  Problem: The f-string literal in expected_lines[1] and expected_lines[2] hardcodes a runner-local absolute path:
  f'[ -f "${{REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT}}" ] || REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT="$/home/runner/work/coding-workflows/coding-workflows/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/{script_name}"'
  f'[ -f "${{REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT}}" ] || REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT="$/home/runner/work/coding-workflows/coding-workflows/.codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/{script_name}"'
  The Python f-string produces literal "$/home/runner/work/coding-workflows/coding-workflows/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/..." and "$-codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/..." text (the $ is a literal character because it is followed by /, not a valid identifier start). The actual workflow .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml uses ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/<script_name> and "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/<script_name>" on those same lines. The expected_lines[1] and expected_lines[2] should produce "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/..." (via ${{GITHUB_WORKSPACE}} in the f-string), matching what the workflow contains.
  Why it fails at runtime: The CI step "Review autofix step-script contract and workflow file size guard tests" in .github/workflows/ci.yml:676-679 runs this test on every PR. The first assertion in test_moved_steps_run_only_the_resolving_wrapper, `assert run_lines[:4] == expected_lines, f"{step_name}: unexpected resolution order:\n{run}"`, compares the first four lines of the workflow step's `run:` block (which contain ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/...) against expected_lines (which contain $/home/runner/work/coding-workflows/coding-workflows/...). The list comparison fails immediately on the first step (Pre-review deterministic merge-topology gate) at line index 1. The test exits non-zero, the CI job fails, and the PR cannot merge. The intent of the test (pinning the wrapper resolution order across SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR, .codex-workflow-src, .codex-workflow-src-main) is correct, but the hardcoded absolute path defeats it.
